title: Quest 'The Slag-Hound' (bearings: 'three north of the head-frame, then three east, where the downs open into the flooded quarry') marked itself done after I killed a generic wandering 'slag-hound' at just 3-north/0-east (The Long Spoil), well before reaching the actual den. The real den, 3 tiles further east at the Flooded Quarry, still held fresh scat, claw marks, and its own separately-named 'a scarred slag-hound' to fight — meaning the quest's own bearings pointed to real, distinct content the completion trigger didn't require visiting.
where: The Long Spoil (Iron Downs) / quest 'The Slag-Hound'
